_comment: One file per class. All classes share the studio05 base body; a class is an animation set plus how our moves map onto its clips. Add a class = add a file here, drop its clips next to the body, point 'animations' at them. 'weapon' is the combat weapon id in data/combat/weapons.json (its overrides hold the class's advance distances: advance = clip hip travel in metres * 7.2, see client/characters/studio05_character_model.gd).
_weapon_families: Weapon items (catalog weapon_type) this class card may wear in its weapon slot, logic/profile.gd card_can_wear (Boss 2026-11-11).
_hair_options: Studio 2026-11-11 index.html hair buttons A, B, C, E, F, G (offered for every class); G = hair/hair_g.glb swapped onto the hair A file.
